title: 6 Weeks pregnant and had brown spotting this morning

posts.body:
I am 6 weeks pregnant and i had brown spotting when i woke up this morning and for an hour or 2 after when i kept wiping myself i cud see just a bit....have had no more. but am really worried as went to A&E this morning and they are sending me for a scan tomorrow...(thurs).  I had an internal scan on monday and they could see a baby and heartbeat. so all was ok then. but am going out of my mind with worry even though i am trying to stay calm.
HELPPPPPPP...i hope this is nothing to worry about.  this is my second pregnancy in 10 years and i had none of this when i was pregnant back then...

Welcome to JP hun
I was told that brown blood is old blood and nothing to worry about, many people spot in the first few weeks and have an implantation bleed.
Why did you have an internal scan?  Seems very early to have a scan, were your dates wrong?  I had to have an internal at my '12week' scan because they couldnt find baby but theyn they deciced I was only 9 weeks
Sounds like A & E are being cautious in sending you for a scan, I am sure it is nothing to worry about.
Good luck tomorrow.

I went for an internal scan last week cos i was having excrutiating pains in abdomen and back like i was been stabbed with sharp knife.  and had the hcg bloods took but that didn't double and it went from 1951 up by 744 to whatever that is....for some reason this time round i feel more worried...don't know why....but i should really calm down and relax or i won't enjoy it...just hoping tomorrow is good news.

Welcome to JP hun  I'm Mandy mum to Lauren and Jake.  It sounds like you have had a tough few weeks hun.  I'm sure it is nothing to worry about and A&E are being cautious (rightly so)  If you have already detected a heartbeat the odds of something happening are less hun.  Lots of people have a small bleed in the early days and it isn't always something yo worry about.  I had spotting with my df for a good couple of weeks in the early days and all was fine.  I did have an early scan though to make sure.  Try not to worry too much hun as stress isn't good for either of you.  I have my fingers crossed all is fine for you hun.  Let us know how you get on   😘  Xx

Firstly welcome to JP
I had the same with this last pregnancy.  I started spotting at 5 weeks and it lasted on and off into week 7.  The scans I had done at 5 and 7 weeks were fine and I gave birth to a healthy baby girl in October this year.
My previous pregnancy was also 10 years ago so I know how you feel. I also had none of these problems when I was pregnant back then!
I did have a MC last year at 8 weeks and the blood quickly went from brown to red and got heavier but it certainly doesn't sound like this is the case with you so I wouldn't worry yourself too much (easier said than done I realise).
Good luck for the next scan hun and let us know how it goes  😘  😘

Went for a scan today and they reassured me that brown spotting is normal...the heartbeat was there and baby fine. which i was so relieved about......they advised me if the blood becomes redder as when she done internal scan she said it was brown with a bit of red, that if it goes redder and bright red then to phone a & e....came home and put my feet up.  dh is waiting on me hand and foot but just been to loo and have had a redder show and am wiping redder blood but not bright red...having  pains but not bad excruiating pains tho....just putting feet up and trying not to worry.....wonder if the redder blood is normal too...thing is if i go a&e now they are not going to do much so am gonna just rest and wait til tomorrow morning.   legs are hurting too like i am coming on a bad period...SO TRYING NOT TO WORRY...  Thanks for all your support in this...much appreciated .

I really hope all goes ok for you hun, It is good news that all was fine today!  Maybe you are having some redder bleeding due to the scan?  Maybe that is why you are having a few cramps aswell, things settling down?  Try not to worry hun, i would go straight back to A&E tonight if you are still worried or if the bleeding gets any heavier though hun  😘  Xx

Thanks for your message.....  I haven't had any more heavier bleeding and it is still a redder bleed but just when wiping....my cramps are still there, but not all time just every 10 mins....but more like a bad period....i am not heavy bleeding and not in excruiating pain so i am hopeful its nothing....not going to go to A&E unless i get bright red bleed and bad pain.   Boobs are still very very sore too....God i hate this...its so different to my last pregnancy maybe thats why i am so worried. but just resting at the moment keeping feet up and drinking loads of water....got scan next thursday and hoping this bleeding will slow down over weekend....
Thanks for ur comments and support.
Hope all is ok with u all...

just an update i have started to bleeding red blood...its not heavy but just coming out slow.  almost like spotting but a bit more.  have had this morning a few very very tiny clots but that was it..  just gonna wait now....if i start clotting and in bad pain which i am not then i will go a and e...just a waiting game unfortunately.
maz
😘 Keep resting hun and go and get yourself checked out again.Hope everything is ok for you. 😘

had some red clotting not big but was there am feeling really sick and quite weak....does anyone know if this means anything bad...am waiting for callback from out of hours gp...thing is tho the epu isn't open now until monday so won't know til then for a scan.......

Hun i really hope all is ok for you.  I would go to A&E now and get checked.  I'm sure they could scan you at emergency department hun! 😘 Xx
Just wanted to add, it still isn't definite bad news hun.  One of my friends is expecting twins, she is 14weeks now and all is going fine so far.  But when she was around 7 weeks she had a really heavy bleed (really heavy, blood running down her legs and everything!)  She went to hospital fearing the worse and had scan.  All was fine, and they have no idea why she had the bleed?  (this was where she found out it was twins too) Hope that gives you a little hope hun 😘  Xx

Hi hun, i went to a&e with a similar thing back in may, i was admitted on to a ward on the saturday night and then scanned first thing on the sunday morning. I should get yourself to a&e, really hope everything is ok, my fingers are crossed for you and bud. xx 😍

Hi Guys about 730 this evening i had an urge to go loo as i felt something ready to come out...and something dropped out so i fished it out(i know that sounds gross) but kept it to show hospital....had very bad cramps and felt sick and very cold straight away....called nhs direct and they told me to call ambulance and went straight to a and e...the doctor said it did look like it was a miscarriage. but when he checked me said my cervix was closed which states no miscarriage. but he said 80 odd percent sure it is...cos i am still bleeding....been sent home just told to rest and have an emergency  scan on monday to confirm it....my dear boyfriend and i have cried so much tonight and i am glad he is here with me.....can't believe it, am sure we will get thru this together...thx for your support guys...will let you know final result on monday....thx again.
😘 what a long wait you ahve until Monday 😘  try and listen to the doctors and rest as much as you can. 😘  keep us informed about how you get on tomorrow.xx

Hi, I am kind of going a little crazy as well. My last period was October 15 so I would have been due for my period this month Nov 11. No period, took the test Nov 14 twice came out positive. Nov 17 started brown spotting for 2 days, Nov 19 almost nothing, Nov 20 started bleeding red like my period was coming but no where near as heavy. The bleeding only lasted a day and a half and went back to brown spotting. Today there is no blood or spotting. I am so confused because I have a 23 month old and never bled with him. Took another pregnancy test yesterday and it came out negative. I have no idea what is going on and I don't have a dr's appointment until Dec 3rd. Does anyone have any imput on what might be going on with me?

I'm not a doctor hun and i don't have a positive answer for you.  I would make another appointment with doc earlier or go to hospital for a definite conclusion.  However i would say that if you had 2 positives and then some bleeding and are now reading negative that you had a very early miscarriage hun?  I really hope i am wrong though. Go and get yourself checked and let us know how you get on hun  😘  😘  😘  Xx

Hi i know i have had a miscarriage cos i passed the sac last night and i know it was that for definate...just gotta go for scan today to check its all gone.....have been crying uncontrollably since it came out last night...we are gonna try again, but just need to get thru this first..
thx for support...

missy ...yer i would go to doctors asap and tell them or call your early pregnancy unit they will advise you....hope its not bad news hun....like mine...but everyone is different anyway....hope u have good news.....good luck....maz

Awww, sorry to hear that hun.  I hope you are coping ok with it all at the moment, it sounds like you have a supportive partner and hopefully together you will cope.  Don't rush into trying again if you don't feel ready though hun.  I hope the scan goes ok and you get a definite answer  😘 Xx

Sorry to hear that Maz1971.  I had the same happen and it upset me beyond words.  However, we tried again and 3 months later I was pregnant and we now have our beautiful baby girl so keep positive hun  😘  😘
I'm very sorry to hear your news also 😘

Mum, thanks for the advice. Maz, so sorry to hear about the mc. I am going to the Dr. today and am hoping for good news but am fearing the worse. I have a feeling I had a mc. At this point I just want to get an answer as to what is going on to put my mind at ease. I will be devastated if it was a mc but I know I will get thru it just like you will. Good Luck with everything and I will let you know what happens.

Well went to the Dr. Doc said it was a chemical pregnancy where the sperm and the egg meet but nothing happens and the body expels it. They did a ultrasound and everything is fine with my uterus and ovaries so I am ok to try again right away. Upset that I am not pregnant but happy there were no other problems or issues.

Hi all...thx for support...went for the scan today it was a complete miscarriage...the womb and the uterus is all back to normal(5 days in all that took)  obviously wasn't meant to be...am feeling ok'ish but have my moments
Have looked on the internet and i am overactive thyroid but cos i wasn't taking my medication it causes miscarriage...so i think that is the reason even though i have no proof. but i feel a bit better know it may of been that...will check with my doc to see if ok and when i can start again and what to do for next time trying....hope all is ok with everyone else on here...good luck to you all.

Oh hun - really sorry to hear your news.
I miscarried at 8 weeks and laso at 13 weeks with twins. However before both miscarraiges i had Georgia-Mae WHO IS NOW 5 AND AM NOW 24+3 with blue bump....
HUGE HUGS XXXXXX  😘

Awwww hun, im so sorry to hear your sad news, there are a few on here that have gone through the same, myself included. So if you do ever need to talk or get anything off your chest, thats what we're here for hun. Take care. xx 😘

Hi, so sorry to hear about ur mc's...i am ok...but keep having moments where i just break down....its hard but time will tell....still have the sac with the baby in it and am burying it in my uncles grave...he died 2 years ago from heart attack...bought a lovely tiny boquet in a vase today to go on the grave and last night bought for the house a peace lily plant(as my db and i liked the name lily if a girl) as we will never know we thought this was nice and appropriate.....
Feeling ok at the moment its just when i am at home on my own...can't seem to go into the toilet where i miscarried but time will tell..
Chat soon guys
Hope all is ok and good luck with ur pregnancies...
Maria xxx

Hi everyone, i had a 12 week dating scan on the 28th of july and my baby had no heartbeat it was heartbreaking i had had no bleeding but i had been very ill sickness and very bad pains. They brought me in the day after for a D&C. I got caught on striaght away it wasn't planned as i'm still getting over what had happened. Now iam 6 weeks pregnant and so far no pain so that is good but i have had some brown discharge and it is worrying me. I also had a slight pinky tint when i wiped myself, but i put that down to me and my partner having sex the night before. Has anybody got any advice xxxxx

So sorry for your loss and congrates on this pregnancy. I hope things go well. As for the brown discharge I would go and get it checked out just because of you mc back in July. They can do a scan at 6 weeks but it might be a transvaginal scan. They will be able to see a heart-beat and your baby should look like  ablob but it is amazing too see. I have to have scans at 6 weeks because of my history of mc and to also see how many babies there are as I have had 3 twin pregnancies, 1 ended in mc, 1 ended with vanising twin syndrome and the other was IG and DR. Goo dlcuk and I hope the brown dischare is just coursed by implantion and nothing else.

Just had my first midwifes appointment and she seemed happy enough with how things wer going, she just said if i get any bleeding to ring her asap. She has booked me in for a scan for about 2 weeks. I just hope and pray everything is ok this time round xxx

Thats brilliant news that the midwife is happy and has got you booked in for a scan in 2 weeks. Finers crossed everythign continues as planned and you see your bubbas heart beat at the scan. Good lcuk and I will be praying and thinking of you until I hear about the scan
Cheers and thankyou for ur support xx
i had very very heavy bleeding andeven went through jeans but they said everything was fine for last 3 weeks, u can stil have a full period for 9 months of pregnancy

That is so true, with my very first pregnancy I still had a full period every 27 days with-out fail and because of this I never foundout I had m/c at 11 weeks which I shoul dof guessed something was wrong as I had cramps which I had never had before that 1 bleed. My aunt also had a pregnancy with periods every month and she refused to believe she was pregnant until she saw the baby on the scan. Very weird how our bodies work I will never be able to understand it

Well it's good news i went for an emergency scan as i was losng alot my blood. The baby was fine and we saw the heart beat so that was a big relief. The reason for the bleeding was because i had i slight hemorage on the outside of my uterus wall which is apparntly pretty normal and no harm to the baby is thats good. Well i'm nearly 10 weeks now and it feels like i've been pregnant for a lifetime lol, i've got my 12 week scan in a couple of weeks so i'm looking forward to that xxx

That's brilliant news so glad everything is OK with bubba. So glad they found out what was coursing the bleeding at that it is something normal no nothig bad. Good luck and I hope the next scan goes just as well. Enjoy your pregnacy and rest as much as you can
